summary: Atmos Energy Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) on June 15, 2026, for an offering of senior notes due 2032. The offering amount, interest rate, maturity date, and pricing terms are blank and will be determined at pricing. The notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with existing and future unsubordinated debt, and will not be listed on any exchange. J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, and Wells Fargo Securities are joint book-running managers. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation.
